conviction_note: Two measurements: findings sum +2.3, led by the published consensus ($61.7-63M Q3, $237.7M FY) apparently leaving out LivePerson, which closed 2026-09-04 and should add roughly $12-15M to Q3 and reset the FY guide up mechanically. That is headline optics on a 42%-of-float short at a 52-week low with upside skew paid. Against it: the informed bar is already about $76M, Q2 organic was lifted by in-period license deals, and the share count keeps growing. So p_up is only 55 on an abs move of 14 (the 13.1% straddle, nudged up for the first combined guide and the crowded short), giving +1.4. The scaled number sits below the sum because the bar is disputed and that uncertainty sits in p_up.
bar: DISPUTED. Published consensus for Q3 2026 revenue: $61.71M and EPS -$0.13 (TipRanks, https://www.tipranks.com/news/soundhound-ai-q3-earnings-today-wall-street-and-options-markets-last-minute-verdict-on-soun-stock, 2026-11-05); $62.2M from 6 analysts, FY26 $237.7M, Q4 $70.9M, FY27 $390.2M (Equibles, https://equibles.com/research/soundhound-ai-soun-q3-2026-earnings-preview-and-forecast, 2026-10-30); $63M Zacks and $62.8M Benzinga (https://financefeeds.com/soun-stock-falls-3-7-ahead-of-q3-earnings-tonight/, 2026-11-05). Equibles says these predate the LivePerson close and leave it out. A post-deal consensus of ~$77.2M is cited by tech-insider via the Motley Fool (https://tech-insider.org/ca/soundhound-ai-q3-earnings-500m-revenue-target-2026/) and could not be verified at its source. Equibles' own estimate is $76.2M ($62.0M SoundHound plus $14.2M for LivePerson's 27 days). Company guide: FY26 $230-260M, which EXCLUDES LivePerson (Q2 call; https://www.tikr.com/blog/soundhound-slips-57-this-year-as-liveperson-deal-adds-25-fortune-100-brands). 2027 target: $350-400M including at least $100M from LivePerson. print_vs_bar_pct is measured against the published $61.7M. My estimate is about $71M reported (organic ~$57-60M plus a ~$12-14M stub after any purchase-accounting haircut), which is +15% on $61.7M but about -7% on the informed $76M. Because the bar cannot be sourced to one agreed number, every finding that depends on it is capped small.
positioning_check: Short interest 170,799,103 shares, 41.87% of float, 10.05 days to cover at the 2026-10-15 settlement, up 7.47% from 2026-09-30 (Quiver/Benzinga, https://www.quiverquant.com/news/SoundHound+AI+Stock+Short+Interest+Rises+to+41.87%25, posted 2026-10-29). Equibles puts it at ~36% of the post-deal share count. No 2026-10-31 settlement figure found. Skew in the baseline: 25d put minus call is -29.29 vol points (upside paid), put/call OI 0.17, ATM IV 223%, straddle 13.14% for the 11-06 expiry. Tape: spot $4.07 at the 52-week low, -26.3% over 20d, -6.7% over 5d, -74% from the 52-week high. Analysts: Piper Sandler Neutral $7 (cut 2026-08-06; a $6 cut on 09-22 is reported by TIKR), Yorkville Ives initiated Hold $6.50 in October, TipRanks average target $10.10-10.92, FY27 coverage down from 5 to 4. Crowded and building short plus call demand: any negative is shrunk for squeeze risk.

findings.finding: Q3 reported revenue will carry roughly $12-15M of LivePerson (closed 2026-09-04; 27 of 92 days; LPSN Q2 2026 revenue $52.5M, 2026 guide $195-207M). That puts reported revenue near $70-76M against a published consensus of $61.7-63M that every major aggregator (TipRanks, Zacks, Benzinga, Equibles' 6-analyst figure) still carries, so the headline will read as a 15-23% 'beat'. The informed bar is ~$76M, and Equibles flags that a purchase-accounting deferred-revenue haircut could cut the stub by several million.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Revenue beats on this name: Q2 2026, $61.9M vs a $52.4M consensus with a raised guide, closed +10.1% (baseline 2026-08-05). Q3 2025, a beat and raise, closed -0.6%. Q2 2025 (2025-08-07) +26.4%. Five straight revenue beats with mixed reactions, so beats are not reliably sold or bought.
findings.why_not_priced: Informed holders know the deal closed, but the headline consensus every wire and algo reads ($61.71M on TipRanks, in the TipRanks and financefeeds previews of 2026-11-04/05) was not updated for the acquisition. If the street had updated, the aggregators would show ~$76M and the previews would not say 'analysts expect $61.7M, +46.9% yoy'. What the headline gap is worth over a full session is uncertain because informed money will net it out, hence the small size.
findings.independence: LPSN Q2 2026 revenue of $52.5M (-11.9% yoy) from TIKR, https://www.tikr.com/blog/soundhound-ai-has-lost-46-in-2026-heres-why-4-straight-cash-flow-misses-matter-more-than-its-revenue-beats (2026-10-11). The 9/04 close date from the LPSN 8-K, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001102993/000119312526380467/d14310dex991.htm (2026-09-02). Consensus that excludes LPSN from https://financefeeds.com/soun-stock-falls-3-7-ahead-of-q3-earnings-tonight/ (2026-11-05). The $76.2M estimate and the haircut caveat come from one source, Equibles.

findings.finding: The FY26 guide of $230-260M explicitly excluded LivePerson, and management said it would update the outlook after close. Folding in the September stub plus a ~$45-48M Q4 LPSN quarter mechanically lifts the range to roughly $290-310M (Equibles models $302M) against an FY consensus of $237.7M. The real test is whether the pre-deal 2027 target of $350-400M (including >=$100M from LivePerson) moves: Equibles notes a combined run-rate well above it, so leaving the range unchanged would signal faster LPSN shrinkage, while raising it would be news.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 2026 low-end raise ($225M to $230M) came with +10.1%. The Q1 2026 reaffirmation of the 2027 $350-400M target came with -7.8% (2026-05-07). Q3 2025's guide raise to $165-180M came with -0.6%.
findings.why_not_priced: FY consensus on aggregators is still $237.7M (range $234.7-240.7M), i.e. inside the ex-LPSN guide, so the headline 'raised guide' will look large. The 2027 decision is genuinely unknown: if it were priced, FY27 consensus ($390M, 4 analysts) would already sit visibly above or below the range rather than inside it.
findings.independence: The guide exclusion is confirmed on the Q2 call (Davidson question) in the quartr/webull summaries, https://www.webull.com/news/15388762580853760. The 2027 target with >=$100M LPSN comes from Piper/Davidson coverage, https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/piper-sandler-lowers-soundhound-ai-nasdaqsoun-price-target-to-700-2026-08-06/ (2026-08-06). This finding rests partly on the same LPSN-excluded-from-consensus fact as finding 1, but lands on a different line (FY/2027 guide).

findings.finding: Q2 2026 organic revenue ($61.9M, +40% q/q from $44.2M) was lifted by in-period license deals. Piper cited 'strength with in-period license deals' with backlog 'go-gets' still to come. The 10-Q shows two customers at 13% and 12% of Q2 revenue while none topped 10% for H1, professional services at $8.3M vs $3.3M a year earlier, and RPO of only $60.0M ($37.3M due within 12 months). So organic Q3 risks falling short of the ~$62M organic consensus (Equibles base case: $57M organic) if the company discloses an ex-LPSN figure.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Quarters where quality or cash was questioned despite a revenue beat: 2026-05-07 -7.8%, 2026-02-26 -4.2%, 2025-05-08 -7.8%.
findings.why_not_priced: Published organic consensus ($61.7-63M) is roughly flat on Q2, i.e. it annualises the license-heavy Q2 rather than modelling a dip. If the street had priced lumpiness, organic estimates would sit nearer $55-57M. Sized small because the LPSN stub may mask organic in the headline, and against a 42% short and upside skew.
findings.independence: Piper Sandler's 2026-08-06 note via https://finance.yahoo.com/news/piper-sandler-cuts-soundhound-ai-141247274.html and https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/piper-sandler-lowers-soundhound-ai-nasdaqsoun-price-target-to-700-2026-08-06/. Equibles' $57M base case (separate source). The TipRanks preview quotes the co-founder saying large OASYS deals drove growth: https://www.tipranks.com/news/soundhound-ai-q3-earnings-tomorrow-options-traders-expect-a-13-move-in-soun-stock.

findings.finding: Dilution kept running into Q3: Class A shares went from 403.3M at 2026-06-30 to 411.6M at 2026-08-06 (+8.3M in five weeks, consistent with ATM use under a Third Equity Distribution Agreement dated 2026-05-11). Q2 ATM sales were 6.2M shares for $47.5M, and the deal added 42.6M more shares. FCF has missed four straight quarters (Q2 -$34.1M vs -$23.8M est.). Asked what the money buys: it funds operating burn, with no corroborated ramp (RPO only $60M), though LivePerson brought ~$96.7M of cash and its notes were retired for stock, so near-term liquidity is not stressed.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean prior print where financing was the line. The stock fell >6% on dilution and technical selling after the deal closed (tradersunion), and 21.6% over the month to mid-October.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: dilution is the dominant bear narrative and the stock is -74% from its high. What is not yet visible is the Q3 share count and cash burn, which the 10-Q/release reveals; the TIKR test (burn under $34M without ATM) likely fails on the July share-count jump alone. Sized small and shrunk for the crowded short.
findings.independence: TIKR on ATM and FCF misses, https://www.tikr.com/blog/soundhound-ai-just-dropped-21-in-a-month-is-it-time-to-sell-or-load-up (mid-Oct 2026). Equibles on share count, LPSN cash and the $300M ATM, https://equibles.com/research/soundhound-ai-soun-q3-2026-earnings-preview-and-forecast (2026-10-30). Equibles says nothing was sold on the ATM in Q2, which the 10-Q contradicts; the 10-Q is used.

findings.finding: Positioning: 170.8M shares short (41.87% of float, 10.05 days to cover) at 2026-10-15, up 7.5% in two weeks, into a stock at its 52-week low after -26% in 20 sessions, with the option market paying for upside (25d skew -29 vol points, put/call OI 0.17). findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the call skew already pays for upside, which is why this is sized at 1. What is not in the price is a forced-cover cascade, which only an outcome triggers.

baseline_tension: Agrees with the baseline: the upside-paid skew, the crowded and building short and the 52-week-low tape all point the same way as the positive headline-optics findings, so much of that is likely in the price. The negatives (lumpy organic, dilution) cut against the skew and are shrunk.
lessons_applied: Lesson 6 (bar disputed: $61.7M published vs ~$76M informed): finding 1, which depends on the published bar, capped from +2.0 to +1.5
Lesson 7 (a negative against a -29 upside skew and a 42% short): organic-lumpiness negative shrunk from -1.0 to -0.8, financing from -0.5 to -0.4
Lesson 4 (financing is a question): answered as funding operating burn with no corroborated ramp, offset by LPSN cash and retired notes; kept a small negative
Lessons 1/3 left the guidance and positioning findings and abs_move/p_up unchanged; p_up already sits at 55 for the disputed bar
